checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Top text exact, no full stop
must.why: Reads WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, no period.

must.item: Bottom text exact, no full stop
must.why: Reads BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY, no period.

must.item: Large white uppercase with black outlines, fits in image
must.why: Bold white letters with black outline, fully inside the frame; top text slightly tight to the edges.

must.item: Same cat and sofa retained, eyes uncovered
must.why: Cat and sofa look unchanged; the eyes are clear, though the top text overlaps the ear tips slightly.

faults.what: Top text touches the ear tips and sits close to the side edges; the letters are tightly packed.

summary: A clean square classic meme with correct text, white letters with black outlines, and the cat's eyes clear, with only minor tight spacing at the top.
